thesis: The halo transfers aesthetic impressions into merits requiring separate evidence.

ideas.statement: Separate clarity, evidence, competence and appearance; average experimental advantages neither diagnose every case nor justify discounting real achievement.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The reported d = 0,37 is standardized effect size, not percentage advantage; developmental pathways and intellectual analogies are hypotheses, not directly measured extensions.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The reported d = 0,37 is standardized effect size, not percentage advantage; developmental pathways and intellectual analogies are hypotheses, not directly measured extensions.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM reading of all units; methodological and normative boundaries retained.
